reason: A is the stronger proposal because it tests both X chemistry and a controlled microstructural extension at genuinely >900 °C, with a defined Mn baseline and explicit falsification, whereas B largely restates the established Al-versus-Mn result and specifies 900 °C rather than above it. A’s claim that multiphase interfaces improve protection is somewhat internally inconsistent and weakly supported, but it is a testable, potentially substantive extension.
